# CodeMonkey

> CodeMonkey is a coding education platform offering block-based and text-based programming games and creative tools for elementary students to learn computer science through game design and puzzle creation.

CodeMonkey provides interactive coding courses and challenges designed for young learners, with a focus on creative learning through game-based activities and student-created content. The platform includes both structured Hour of Code activities and advanced tools like Challenge Builder for students to design their own programming puzzles.

## Key Topics

- Block-based coding
- CoffeeScript
- Challenge Builder
- Hour of Code
- Game-based learning
- Student-created content
- Elementary education
- Game design
- Coding games
- Classroom activities
- Creative learning
- Programming concepts

## Core Learning Platforms

- [Challenge Builder](https://www.codemonkey.com/courses/challenge-builder): Platform enabling students to code and create their own puzzles, transitioning from learning to creating
- [Blocks Jumper](https://www.codemonkey.com/hour-of-code/blocks-jumper): Block-based coding game for elementary students with integrated progress tracking

## Teacher Resources

- [Beaver Achiever Teacher Notes](https://www.codemonkey.com/hour-of-code/beaver-achiever/teacher-notes): Instructional guide for Beaver Achiever block-coding game designed for 6-7 year olds
